## Activity

During August 2022, Central Eye Clinic recorded 10 image captures. Capture activity was completed in line with the clinic’s operating arrangements, and session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity information indicates that the service continued to provide imaging during the reporting month without a reported interruption to scheduled sessions.

## Image quality

Image quality outcomes were favourable for the reporting period. A total of 0 captures were assessed as ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 0.0. This indicates that all captured image sets were available for grading and that no additional imaging was required because of an ungradable result.

## Grading

Grading identified 4 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 16 days. This measure provides the central indication of the time taken for results to progress through grading during August 2022. The results should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality findings above when reviewing the clinic’s operational performance for the month.
